scope: 30 synthetic development cases; actual scorer answers and router choices; no held-out cases or private judge.

scoring_criteria.product: Pipeline forecasting software for B2B sales teams
scoring_criteria.fit: B2B SaaS, verified 50–1000 employees and at least 10 sales staff.
scoring_criteria.exclude: Agencies and accounts with an authoritative, unexpired competitor contract.
scoring_criteria.priority: Resolve conflicting or insufficient evidence at score 3 / not_icp. Otherwise: exclusions 1; current budget freeze 2; fit 4; fit with fresh evaluation/demo request 5.
scoring_criteria.contract: score 1–5; one listed reason_code; 1–2 distinct evidence_ids from this account.
